key.questaddons.keys.move_selection: Move Selection (hold + click a selected quest)
key.questaddons.keys.toggle_optional: Toggle Optional (hover a quest task, or hold + right-click a quest)
key.questaddons.keys.quest_filter: Smart Filter From Quest Items (in your inventory, from the hotbar, or the whole inventory with Shift)
key.questaddons.keys.split_view: Split View (two chapters side by side)
key.questaddons.keys.split_view_stacked: Split View Stacked (two chapters one above the other)
questaddons.gui.collapse.tooltip: Hides the subtitle and description, keeping the tasks and rewards
questaddons.gui.expand.tooltip: Shows the subtitle and description again
questaddons.gui.fix_json.tooltip: Repairs every broken JSON text line in this description
questaddons.gui.preview.tooltip: Shows the description beside the editor as players will see it, updating as you type, at the width the quest shows it
ftbquests.questaddons.live_preview_open: Open Live Preview with the Editor
Whether the quest description editor opens with Live Preview shown. Alt + V still toggles it while you edit
questaddons.gui.insert_keybind.tooltip: Picks any keybind, bound or not, and adds it to the description as JSON at the cursor
questaddons.gui.insert_item.tooltip: Picks an item and adds its name at the cursor, showing the item's tooltip on hover
questaddons.gui.insert_command.tooltip: Adds a link that runs a command when clicked, wrapping the selection if there is one
questaddons.gui.insert_copy.tooltip: Adds a link that copies text to the clipboard when clicked
questaddons.gui.insert_font.tooltip: Picks any loaded font and applies it to the selection, or adds placeholder text in it
questaddons.gui.insert_guideme.tooltip: Picks a GuideMe page and adds a link that opens it, wrapping the selection if there is one
questaddons.gui.insert_patchouli.tooltip: Picks a Patchouli entry and adds a link that opens it, wrapping the selection if there is one
questaddons.smart_filter.no_items: This quest has no item tasks
questaddons.smart_filter.creative_only: Creative mode is needed to make a Smart Filter
questaddons.smart_filter.inventory_full: No free inventory slot for the Smart Filter
questaddons.smart_filter.mod_missing: FTB Filter System is not installed
questaddons.gui.view_dependencies.highli: Left-click to pop the window out and highlight dependencies in the book
questaddons.gui.view_dependencies.show_p: Right-click to show the dependencies beside the window
questaddons.gui.view_dependencies.hide_p: Right-click to hide the dependencies panel
questaddons.gui.dependencies.filter.tool: Click to change the view, right-click to go back
questaddons.gui.keep_window.tooltip: Floats the window where it is, so it stays open while you browse
questaddons.gui.release_window.tooltip: Puts the window back in the middle, where browsing closes it
questaddons.gui.pinned_tracker.reset: Right-click to put it back where the FTB Quests settings place it
questaddons.gui.pinned_tracker.open: Click to open in the quest book
questaddons.gui.pinned_tracker.locked: Locked until its dependencies are done
